presentation/view/batch_atlas.gd (NEW): dynamic 2048x2048 RGBA8 atlas pages, shelf packer, add(key,img), page_of/rect_of, flush() uploads dirty pages once per frame.

presentation/view/batch_art.gd (NEW): entity -> atlas region resolver. Same frame choice as ArtCatalog.entity_sprite (fire / walk_a+walk_b / move, facing row, ph = floor(t*6 + id*0.37)). Units use the team-tinted SHEET from ArtCatalog._sheet; buildings/resources/wrecks/rubble go through resolve_static (cached by def|colour|state); missing art falls back to ViewUtil.fallback_sprite. The per-id cache _ec is read directly by entity_layer (unit cache = [def, owner, page, origin, fw, fh, -pivot, fire, walk, wa, wb, mv, is_air]; page -2 means fallback).

presentation/view/lod_icons.gd (NEW): far-zoom icons per class (infantry/vehicle/air), tinted by modulate. Reads optional manifest block lod_icons {<faction_def or *>: {<class>: {file, pivot}}} (format posted to ART4 on the board, seq 509). Until then it draws a procedural dot (air = diamond).

presentation/view/entity_layer.gd (REWRITTEN): one CanvasItem. Decor is bucketed into 16x16-cell chunks with screen bounds. Each frame: view-rect cull (MARGIN 220), inline interpolation from mv._prev_pos/_alpha, fog rules unchanged (enemy units only on visible cells incl. ally vision; enemy buildings while visible, else remembered greyed; wrecks once seen; resources once explored; ghosts of destroyed remembered buildings). Y-sort via PackedInt64Array keys (layer*2^44 + (y+65536)*2^22 + idx) with native sort(); layer 1 = air (lifted by G3View.air_lift), layer 2 = far icons. LOD: zoom < 0.8 -> lod 1 (mid), < 0.45 -> lod 2 (far icons). Public: lod, drawn, decor_count, setup, refresh, on_destroyed.

presentation/view/terrain_layer.gd (REWRITTEN): maps with <= 64 chunks (96x96 = 36) are baked eagerly, with identical output to before. Larger maps are lazy: a low-res base (1 texel per cell, iso transform, linear filter) plus chunks near the view baked on WorkerThreadPool (max 3 pending, results via mutex), LRU eviction past 56 chunks, and the base only at zoom < 0.45. Tile images are prefilled on the main thread for codes 0..15 (MAX_CODE). Chunk sprites are forced to TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST. New tick() is called each frame. rebake_cells kept (also updates the base on lazy maps).

presentation/view/fog_layer.gd (REWRITTEN): the visible/explored byte arrays upload straight into two L8 textures (Image.set_data, no per-cell loop). A canvas shader does manual bilinear between cell centres of alpha (visible 0, explored 120/255, unexplored 1), matching the old LA8+linear look. It re-uploads only when an array changes.
presentation/view/fx_layer.gd: var lod (set by MatchView), view culling in _draw, lod>=1 drops muzzle/explosion_small/small smoke (not created in on_shot either), lod 2 also drops tracers; var drawn.
presentation/view/overlay_layer.gd: _draw_bars culls to the camera view.

presentation/match_view.gd: new flags --map=<id> (regenerates the fresh world with cfg.map when tick==0 and the map differs, printing 'MAP --map=... WxH'), --zoom=<f> (sets camera.zoom directly, bypassing the clamp), --fps-quit=S (prints FPS_SUMMARY avg/min/p10/max, skipping the first 3 samples, then quits). Spawn-test now centres the camera on the player's units (_center_on_spawn_test). terrain_layer.tick() and fx_layer.lod = entity_layer.lod are called in _process.
